data.title: 早露 · 相册里的旧合照
data.description: 她在一张合照前停下来，指认照片里熟悉的面孔。说到某件趣事时，早露自己也笑了。
data.camera: 中近景，相册与双手清晰
data.promptProse: On a comfortable, cushioned window seat, Rosa flips through an expansive, leather-bound family photo album, her face lighting up with nostalgic fondness as she encounters a cherished childhood photograph. Soft twilight filters through the window pane, casting a gentle, moody glow over the aged paper pages, photo corners, and her reflective, sentimental expression.
